Our Story
Family-Owned Farm Supply in
Corning, Iowa.
Big box stores don't always get what farmers truly need. At Feeders Grain & Farm Supply, we do — because we're farmers too.
Meet Erica, our owner, and hear how her journey from loyal customer to business owner shaped the way we serve our community.
